title: Gravity and the shape of fire
note: Approved narration (alanzim/learn/videos-design.md). Drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code); approved by AlanziM2. Editing a recorded script costs ElevenLabs credits.

sentences.say: On Earth, a flame has a shape we all know: a flickering teardrop.
sentences.show: On Earth, a flame has a shape we all know: a flickering teardrop.

sentences.say: Gas heated by the flame is lighter than the air around it, so it rises, and cooler air rushes in underneath.
sentences.show: Gas heated by the flame is lighter than the air around it, so it rises, and cooler air rushes in underneath.

sentences.say: The push on that hot gas is the difference in density, times gravity.
sentences.show: The push on that hot gas is the difference in density, times gravity.

sentences.say: On the space station, nothing is lighter or heavier. Hot gas stays where it is.
sentences.show: On the space station, nothing is lighter or heavier. Hot gas stays where it is.

sentences.say: Oxygen can only reach the flame by slowly drifting in, so the flame becomes a small, steady, dim blue sphere.
sentences.show: Oxygen can only reach the flame by slowly drifting in, so the flame becomes a small, steady, dim blue sphere.

sentences.say: Without fresh air arriving, a flame in orbit can even smother itself.
sentences.show: Without fresh air arriving, a flame in orbit can even smother itself.

sentences.say: The Moon and Mars sit in between, at one sixth and about three eighths of Earth's gravity.
sentences.show: The Moon and Mars sit in between, at one sixth and about three eighths of Earth's gravity.

sentences.say: Every one of NASA's 1,276 fire tests in this database ran in microgravity. Nobody has measured a fire at Moon gravity yet.
sentences.show: Every one of NASA's 1,276 fire tests in this database ran in microgravity. Nobody has measured a fire at Moon gravity yet.

sentences.say: So for a Moon Base, the honest answer lies somewhere between space and Earth.
sentences.show: So for a Moon Base, the honest answer lies somewhere between space and Earth.
